parameters.name: CrossBackupId
parameters.description: The ID of the cross-region data backup file. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query the backup file ID.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-available-recovery-time --cross-backup-id 124930000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --region cn-hangzhou
